name: TV Night
description: Turn a mood, episode-length constraint, commitment preference, or a few favorite series into a focused TV-show shortlist. Public Trakt metadata is required; an authorized Trakt account can optionally add personalized recommendation context, while TMDB artwork, trailers, and Brave streaming evidence further enrich the dated Canvas result. Example: /tv_night thoughtful mystery like Severance and Dark, episodes under an hour, preferably a completed series.

show_request.default: Give me a varied TV-show shortlist from current public Trakt signals.

steps.abort_speech: TV Night needs the Trakt public TV-show tool. Configure TRAKT_API_KEY with a Trakt application Client ID in the active mode environment.
steps.description: Build the required source-ranked TV candidate set from public Trakt metadata
Optionally add read-only personalized Trakt recommendations and deterministically exclude watched public/account candidates without exposing raw history
Optionally enrich the leading recommendation with TMDB series metadata and a balanced artwork bundle
Optionally verify and display trailer choices for the leading series

params.query: Current US streaming availability for the TV series ${top_title} ${top_year}, ${second_title}, and ${third_title}; check HBO Max, Paramount Plus, Prime Video, Amazon, YouTube, Netflix, Apple TV Plus, Hulu, Peacock, and Disney Plus. Viewer request: ${show_request}

steps.description: Optionally check current US streaming evidence for the leading candidates
Create the dated Canvas TV-show recommendation brief

success_speech: Your TV-show shortlist is ready in Canvas. The top recommendation is ${top_title}.
partial_speech: Your TV-show shortlist is ready in Canvas using Trakt and the optional artwork, trailer, or streaming sources that were available.
abort_speech: TV Night could not be completed. Configure the Trakt Client ID or include a clearer TV mood or favorite series.
